pitchRule: exact fretted MIDI; bends not converted to sounding pitch
matching: one-to-one maximum count then minimum total absolute onset error per pitch
boundary: Both predicted and target onsets inside half-open window; no outside-window matches
exclusions: No duration, bend, fingering, role or full-song accuracy claim. Whole-mix unmatched events are only unmatched to this rhythm fixture, not proven false musical notes.
referenceQuality: Historical repeated two-bar fixture, not a fresh note-by-note audit of the complete sheet
selection: One fixed grid and tolerance; no offset/tempo search; no prediction tuning
